items.title: 3- ZW–ZZ System of Sex Determination (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 3- ZW–ZZ System of Sex Determination: a main subheading of Systems of Sex Determination, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 104-105.

blocks.text: Jins tay karne ka yeh tareeqa parindon (birds) mein aam hai. Mukhtalif parindon mein autosomes ki tadaad mukhtalif hoti hai, lekin sex chromosomes maada mein ZW aur nar mein ZZ hote hain. Yaani maada parinda do qisam ke eggs banata hai: aadhe Z wale aur aadhe W wale, jab ke nar ke sab sperm mein Z hota hai. Jab Z wala egg sperm se fertilize ho to bachcha nar (ZZ) hota hai; jab W wala egg fertilize ho to bachcha maada (ZW) hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai 'When a Y carrying egg is fertilized ... offspring is female'. Parindon mein Y chromosome hota hi nahi; ZW–ZZ nizam mein maada (ZW) dene wale egg mein W chromosome hota hai, is liye sahi 'W carrying egg' hai.

blocks.alt: Aik qatar mein teen hisse. Insan (XX-XY nizam): maada 44 + XX, nar 44 + XY; maada gametes X, X aur nar gametes X, Y se XX aur XY. Tidda (XX-XO nizam): maada 22 + XX, nar 22 + X-; nar gametes X aur - (koi sex chromosome nahi) se XX aur X-. Murghi (ZW-ZZ nizam): maada 76 + ZW, nar 76 + ZZ; maada gametes Z, W aur nar gametes Z, Z se ZZ aur ZW. Maada bachche hare, nar gulabi.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.13: Janwaron mein jins ka tay hona (sex determination) (kitab ki Figure 18.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har hisse mein 2 x 2 grid: baen Female gametes, oopar Male gametes.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 18.13 mein maada tidde (grasshopper) ko 22 + XY likha hai. XX-XO nizam mein maada 22 + XX hoti hai, is liye hamare khaake mein 22 + XX hai. Kitab ki murghi wali grid mein ZZ ko maada aur ZW ko nar ka rang diya gaya hai; yahan ZW (maada) hara aur ZZ (nar) gulabi hai, baqi do hisson ki tarah.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeno hisson mein 2 × 2 grid hai: baen taraf female gametes, oopar male gametes. Insan aur tidde mein nar do qisam ke sperm banata hai (X aur Y, ya X aur kuch nahi), is liye baap jins tay karta hai. Murghi mein maada do qisam ke eggs (Z aur W) banati hai, is liye maa jins tay karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Parindon mein bachche ki jins kaun sa walid tay karta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Maa. Woh ZW hai aur Z aur W do qisam ke eggs banati hai, jab ke baap (ZZ) sirf Z wale sperm banata hai.

items: XX-XY (insan, Drosophila): nar heterogametic; sperm jins tay karta hai.
XX-XO (tidda): nar XO, 23 chromosomes; nullo sperm se nar.
ZW-ZZ (parinde): maada heterogametic; egg jins tay karta hai.
